transforms.effect: The usage upsert has no per-minute field. Rollout context is explicitly not burn.

applicability.notes: An adapter unit test observes a projected burnRatePerMin, including 0 after a downward child correction. That number is the shared projector, not an adapter field. field.tokens.perMinute stays pending. The contract row is not written by the adapter. Mapping into MonitorAgentRow is pending and owned by GV-AUDIT2. This trace is Puppeteer 748d015a7e393112e0a91dad80111fdf5abe6583 only. It is newer than shipped Vibefield 0.3.3 and does not describe that install. Package comparison was not re-run. Declaration supported from codex-thread-token-usage. declaration only; supported does not guarantee availability/value; degraded is not unreachable A missing or unsupported adapter signal does not rule out the row value from host, runtime, or another producer. Upstream states: adapter.codex.upstream.burn.absent="absent" (adapter usage value); adapter.codex.upstream.burn.test-projection="not an emission" (monitor.test.ts reads project().usage.burnRatePerMin) Continuation: MonitorService.consume then core reduce and project, then deriveAgentRow. Vibefield AgentView and window-rows are not traced.
